scope: fixtures/retirement-c4-acceptance-owner.md (R1.6 + C4 portion of R1.4/R1.5, issue #1895/epic #1891) — read-only fixture review against live source, spec delta, tasks.md and design.md
summary: The fixture is comprehensive, internally consistent, and accurately grounded in the actual C4 binder CLI/core, shared safe_fs/safe_fs_publication/evidence_io/node27_pgdata_command primitives, the C1 record's real selected fields, and the old C3 bind guarantee it transfers. Risk-pack selection, the invariant matrix, freeze/bind/verify temporal and identity chaining, no-rederive/no-clobber semantics, evidence-floor separation of real-Node proof vs synthetic vs live claims, and R1.4/R1.5/epic false-closure guards all verify against cited source. One concrete gap blocks approval: the selector/dependency mapping enumerates exactly four shared producer files but does not close the shared-dependency set — the fixture's own error contract makes packages/common/redaction.py the realistic fifth shared dependency, and its existing producer rule selects only tests/test_redaction.py. One surgical sentence fixes it. A non-blocking note asks to name the two runbook registration targets, matching sibling-fixture convention.

If the implementer imports the shared redaction module — the convention-conforming choice — a later redaction.py change selects only tests/test_redaction.py (scripts/select_ci_tests.py:2535-2538), never the new acceptance suites, so a regression in the credential-leakage guard ships without PR-time selection. The fixture neither names redaction.py nor states a static-only/owner-local error design that would make the four-file enumeration complete.

verified_pass: Three-stage CLI contract matches binder reality: c4-receipt-binder.mjs takes exactly --receipt/--frontend-origin/--api-origin/--basin-id/--segment-id/--cmd-start/--cmd-end and prints 'BINDER: PASS\n' only when acceptC4Receipt returns ok, exit 1 otherwise (apps/frontend/scripts/c4-receipt-binder.mjs:44-49; core acceptC4Receipt missing-arg and refusal paths) — 'successful exit AND actual PASS output, not substring/exit-only acceptance' is executable as written.

Bracket timing chain is closed and grounded: the binder enforces STRICT_DECIMAL ^\d{1,10}$ ordered seconds (core requireCmdBracket), receipt started_at >= cmd-start, ended_at <= cmd-end (validatePassDocument tail), and receipt mtime within [cmd-start, cmd-end] (acceptC4Receipt pathname-facts block); the fixture adds freeze-time <= cmd-start with the bracket recorded once at bind from the real producer invocation — a fabricated bracket that does not contain the receipt fails, and verify re-runs with the ORIGINAL bracket from the binding (no bracket args on verify), so expectations are never rederived.

Origin rules identical to the binder: fixture 'http/https and empty or / path only, no credentials/query/fragment' == normalizedOrigin (c4-receipt-binder-core.mjs normalizedOrigin); 'leave semantic origin comparison to the real binder' avoids duplicated C4 semantic validation.

Approved-source selected-fields contract accurate: C1 REQUIRED_KEYS include status/head_sha/reviewed_sha with status='PASS' and head_sha==reviewed_sha==expected (node27_issue1895_display_runtime.py:63-78,:349-351,:381-383), and grep confirms zero basin/segment occurrences in that module — the fixture's 'explicit C4 config from operator because C1 does NOT emit basin/segment' is correct, and the 'may have other bounded fields' wording correctly avoids re-importing the full C1 validator.

FileIdentity gap claim accurate: evidence_io.FileIdentity is exactly path/normalized_path/device/inode/size/sha256 (packages/common/evidence_io.py:53-61) — it lacks uid/mode/nlink/mtime/ctime as stated, so the stricter owner-local signature (dev/ino/uid/mode/nlink/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns + same-held-fd SHA-256) is genuinely required and 'do not extend FileIdentity' protects its other frozen consumers.

Publication composition matches reality: safe_fs_publication.write_bytes_no_follow_exclusive(path, content, *, containment_root, require_durable_create, mode) exists with the exact cited kwargs including mode=0o600 exact-after-create semantics and indeterminate-kind durable-create proof (safe_fs_publication.py write_bytes_no_follow_exclusive); move_regular_file_no_follow_exclusive is link-then-unlink, FileExistsError on existing destination, keeps the source on indeterminate proof — faithfully reproducing the old commit temp-sibling pattern (node27_issue1895_commit.py:211-302: O_EXCL 0600 temp, fsync, exclusive move, inode-swap/readback/parent-durability/temp-residue checks, refuse-not-delete on uncertainty) through existing shared primitives with no old-graph import.

Same-held-fd before/after identity capture is composable: safe_fs.open_file_no_follow/open_directory_no_follow return pinned fds; the binder core itself pins fstat + pathname + parent identity across its read (recheckPinnedIdentities) — the outer Python capture around the black-box subprocess adds no binder change and covers same-size content change, inode replacement and mode/nlink/mtime/ctime drift as the invariant matrix claims.

Old C3 guarantee accurately characterized: bind_c3_receipt binds reviewed SHA (head==reviewed==expected), C4 raw sha256 + full facts equality, and bracket (node27_issue1895_publication_current.py:613-647); the fixture re-establishes only that outer guarantee and explicitly retires the registry/GFS-IFS/frontier/job/log checks to later slices, matching both the migration census and the spec delta's MODIFIED requirement wording.

No-old-graph constraint satisfiable: the composition set (node27_pgdata_command.run_bounded_command with CommandError + runner injection kwarg; safe_fs; safe_fs_publication; evidence_io; shared redaction.py outside issue1895) contains zero node27_issue1895_* imports, while the old owner's consumers (observer/binder scripts, c14 owner map, C3 tests, census/reconcile/timer/performance wrappers) are correctly enumerated as not dependencies of standalone C4.

Selector rule sites for all four named producer files exist (scripts/select_ci_tests.py:1548-1563 safe_fs + safe_fs_publication rules with explicit 'extended at the rule site' consumer tuples, :3521-3524 evidence_io → ISSUE1895_READINESS_C1_C2_C3_TESTS, :4267+ node27_pgdata_command consumer tuple) — extending them with the new suites 'without shrinking prior consumers' is executable; existing frontend binder suites (apps/frontend/src/__tests__/c4ReceiptBinderCore.test.ts, c4Typecheck.test.ts) remain under normal frontend scope untouched.

R1.4/R1.5/epic false-closure guards are explicit and consistent with tasks.md: header and non-goals keep the SQL/API/ingest workload as the next R1.4 slice, the census row repeats it, and the evidence floor forbids marking all R1.4/R1.5/epic done while requiring the real entrypoint/code-owner/provenance record before R1.6 is marked done — matching the DAG row 'C4 acceptance before G0/C3 removal' and R1.6's 'generic C4-survives wording is not proof'.

Risk-pack selection is complete for this seam (CLI entry, config/setup, file IO/path safety/overwrite, schema/fields, auth/secrets, concurrency/ordering, resource limits, legacy compatibility, error/rollback/partial output, packaging/dependency, docs/migration; domain: published NHMS/display identity) and the not-selected packs are correctly justified (no DB/SQL, Slurm, geospatial, SHUD numerics, providers, manifest/QC on this seam).

Invariant matrix covers every assignment-required axis with concrete proofs: approval source swap/SHA mismatch, binder PASS/FAIL/nonzero/timeout/malformed with no exit-only/fake-PASS, storage/identity drift classes, freeze→producer→bind→verify ordering with no mutable refresh, unchanged C4/river-click consumers, failure/publication no-clobber/no-unsafe-cleanup/no-fd-leak, and evidence/docs truthful labeling.

Evidence floor is executable and separates proof classes: process-boundary injection via run_bounded_command's runner kwarg keeps Node out of ordinary backend CI; the real freeze/bind/verify-around-real-Node run with negative byte/SHA/identity/binder cases is distinguished from synthetic fixture receipts (labeled fixture proof, never live production PASS) and from readonly live-producer exercise with truthful PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL — consistent with tasks.md R5.1 and the live lane (package.json test:e2e:live-c4-display, e2e/live-c4-display.spec.ts).

Non-goals contain no whole-epic readiness renegotiation: cold deletion, SQL workload transfer, new trust/signature platform, C4 closed-protocol changes, node22, archive and epic closure are all explicitly out; the MODIFIED c4-live-display-evidence delta is applied with this slice by Main only.
verification_gaps: Read-only fixture review per the leaf-reviewer boundary: no tests, selector runs, openspec validation, lint or builds were executed; all claims rest on direct inspection of the cited lines in this worktree. The fixture governs a not-yet-implemented slice, so conformance of the eventual implementation (exact timeout value, error-composition mechanism, red proof) remains the implementer's node-27 evidence duty and the four-seat cross-review's gate, not something this review can settle.
residual_risks: Freeze-time vs cmd-start comparison must remain a strict instant comparison (freeze UTC no later than the cmd-start second value); an implementer 'helpfully' truncating the sub-second freeze timestamp to whole seconds would admit a freeze up to ~1s after producer start, marginally weakening the freeze-before-execution invariant — cross-review should pin the comparison direction.

If the shared redaction module is used (expected), note that redaction.py imports psycopg2.extensions at module scope (redaction.py:9); a module-scope import in the new CLI would make even --help fail on a driver-less host. The archived convention is function-local import for such CLIs, or acceptance that the CLI runs only in the node-27 venv — either should be a conscious, review-checked choice.

The concrete fixed timeout/output ceiling for the bounded binder invocation is implementer freedom within 'finite'; cross-review should reject user-supplied executable/runner/timeout options and confirm the ceiling comfortably covers Node startup plus a 256 KiB receipt read on a loaded node-27.

The acceptance record is terminal private evidence with no downstream consumer in this slice; final production handoff remains R5 and must not read this slice's existence as deployment completion — the fixture states this, and the R5 audit remains the enforcement point.
